name: SaunaLife G2 | 4-Person Traditional Outdoor Sauna
description: Description The Garden-Series Model G2 Outdoor Sauna from SaunaLife is a truly superior quality sauna at an unmatched value. Exceptional 1.65”-thick spruce planks with interlocking V-joints create an incredibly robust structure designed for a lifetime of use. A slanted roof with premium, self-gluing EPDM roofing and a full floor keeps the elements out, while bathers enjoy supreme comfort. Spacious and Comfortable The comfortable benches and backrests are crafted from beautiful hand-selected, satin-smooth Aspen. Dotless and dimmable LED lighting provides indirect illumination and enhances the natural beauty of the wood interior. The 8mm-thick tempered glass door with professional-quality door-pull and A Wellness Sanctuary at Home This luxurious 4-person backyard sauna can elevate your daily health regimen and provide a lifetime of wellness and relaxation for the whole family. Live the Sauna Life! sturdy hinges further showcase the outstanding quality of this amazing home sauna. Versatile Heating Options The G2 can is large enough for a wood-fired sauna stove or can be configured with a 6kW electric sauna heater. A heater safety guard is included. Enjoy a lifetime of wellness in your own backyard and Live the SaunaLife! This simple, well-built sauna will blend nicely into your outdoor space. It has a light spruce wood exterior with a glass door to let in natural light and give a view to the outdoors. It will work with either an electric sauna heater or wood-fired sauna stove. Features 4 person capacity Simple DIY Sauna Kit (2-persons, 2-days) 1.65” thick spruce planks with interlocking V-joints Two-tier, satin smooth knotless Aspen benches and backrests Dimmable LED lighting with remote control 5/16" Clear Tempered Glass Door Slanted roof with self-adhesive EPDM roofing Designed and crafted in Estonia Limited 2-Year Warranty Includes Pre-cut Spruce boards for entire structure Aspen Benches and Backrests Tempered clear glass door Foundation beams EPDM self-adhesive roofing Air exhaust vent Exterior trim White LED light bar (1) & remote control Fasteners Installation instructions Heater sold separately Choose a matched heater package in the heater options on this page, or contact us if you'd like a different heater. Specifications Sauna Interior Volume: 192 cu ft Structure Material: Nordic Spruce Bench Material: Knotless Aspen Interior Dimensions: 59"D x 66"W x 85"H Exterior Height: 92" (front) and 85" (back) Exterior Dimensions of Foundation: 64"D and 72"W Exterior Dimensions of Roof: 75"D and 86"W (eave to eave) Door: 27.2" W x 66.6" H Door Handle Material: Aluminum (Exterior)/Wood Shipping Dimensions: 89"L x 44"W x 32"H Shipping Weight: 1200 lbs Lighting Voltage: 120V AC Manual Installation Manual
